claim: GNDEC ECE Major Project evaluation is split 60% internal / 40% external, totaling 200 marks across five reviews.
stance_target: how Indian B.Tech ECE major projects are formally graded
scope_conditions: Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College (autonomous, Ludhiana, India), ECE department, 2014 batch onwards
quoted_support: Over all Weightage ... 60% (120) [internal, Reviews 1-5] ... 40% (80) [External Evaluation] ... Total 100% (200)

claim: The five-review structure moves from proposal (9%) through mid-term (9%), end-semester (15%), report (15%), to guide evaluation (12%).
stance_target: structure of Indian B.Tech major project milestone reviews
quoted_support: Review 1 Project Synopsis/ Proposal Evaluation Rubric R1 9% (18) ... Review 3 End Semester Project Evaluation Rubric R3 15% (30) ... Review 4 Project Report Evaluation Rubric R4 15% (30)

claim: Project synopsis/proposal rubric grades students on problem identification, feasibility study of existing systems, and clarity of objectives/methodology, each on a 5-tier scale from Excellent to Unacceptable.
stance_target: what criteria Indian institutions use to evaluate a proposed B.Tech ECE project topic
scope_conditions: GNDEC ECE Rubric R1, Project Synopsis/Proposal Evaluation
quoted_support: Identification of Problem Domain and Detailed Analysis ... Study of the Existing Systems and Feasibility of Project Proposal ... Objectives and Methodology of the Proposed Work

claim: Mid-term evaluation explicitly grades design methodology (modular decomposition, framework selection), project planning/team structure (time frame adherence, work distribution), and presentation delivery (eye contact, voice, arrangement).
stance_target: what Indian mid-term project reviews assess beyond raw technical output
scope_conditions: GNDEC ECE Rubric R2, Mid-Term Project Evaluation
quoted_support: Divison of problem into modules and good selection of computing framework ... Time frame properly specified and being followed ... Proper eye contact with audience and clear voice with good spoken language
